shared_elements: row of similar figures aligned along a horizontal axis
horizontal band of repeated small motifs acting as a border/register divider
figures rendered in profile with the body flattened against the ground
justification: Both surfaces stack their imagery into horizontal registers, and in each a line of repeated profile figures (human-and-animal procession in A, row of crouching quadrupeds in B) sits directly above a narrow band of repeated small motifs that functions as a divider. Beyond that generic register-and-frieze logic the works diverge sharply: A is a smooth, finely modelled flat wall panel with carefully proportioned, detailed figures and ornamental rosette borders, while B is a rough, blocky free-standing pillar whose schematic, heavily abstracted animals sit at differing scales and orientations with no unified ground line.
